conditions: Selected physical register inputs, valid disjoint storage and normal Win64 helper returns.
Stable zero query header, finite valid zero-terminated byte strings, stable cache nodes and views.
Matched TypeDef points into the same selected live metadata table at a valid aligned record index.
Registration type index and pointer select a valid readable 16-byte type record; no identity is inferred from proximity.

evidenceBoundary.exact: Complete PE-owned code inventories and normal local control/frame geometry for the selected lookup, cache insert, cache lookup, class resolver and constructor bodies.
evidenceBoundary.direct: Selected key construction, four byte-comparison loops, matched record-to-index transfer, two raw type copies and later address passed to an opaque callee.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: After selecting a stable zero key header, both query comparisons dominate the non-sentinel hit write; valid matched record offsets yield the selected metadata index.
evidenceBoundary.structuralOnly: Unselected hash, insertion, resolver and constructor effects remain physical inventory; whole helper semantics are not claimed.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Runtime strings/cache/global identity and coherence, empty-cache helper output, actual returned named class, later type-copy preservation, concrete enum sharing and Buff root admission.
